headline: MacKinnon (lower-body) is expected to be out for 12 weeks.
Kaprizov (undisclosed) will play Sunday vs. the Blue Jackets.
Guentzel (rest) will not play against the Rangers on Wednesday.
Nylander (illness) is on the ice for warmups; he's expected to play vs. the Sharks.
Oettinger will start vs. Nashville on Wednesday.
news: In just 18 games this season, Oettinger has already matched a career high with five shutouts, while no other goalie has more than two. The 27-year-old Oettinger was terrific in his most recent game, saving all 33 shots he faced in a 1-0 win over the Pittsburgh Penguins. In his last four games (4-0-0), Oettinger has a stellar 1.46 GAA and .946 SV%. The Stars enter Wednesday's game as -167 home favourites against the Nashville Predators, who are 8-2-0 in their past 10 games.

headline: Schaefer (illness) will play vs. New Jersey on Tuesday.
news: Schaefer was absent from practice on Monday due to illness, but he attended the team's morning skate on Tuesday and will be in the lineup in the evening against the New Jersey Devils. The 18-year-old rookie's tremendous season continued in the Islanders' most recent game, recording two goals, including the overtime winner, in a 4-3 victory over the Toronto Maple Leafs. He has 28 points (12G / 16A) in 42 games this season.

headline: Marner (personal) returned to practice on Monday.
news: Marner has missed the past two games, tending to a personal matter, but was back at practice on Monday and will likely be back in the lineup on Tuesday against the Ottawa Senators. The 29-year-old Marner is off to a strong start this season, with 12 points (2G / 10A) in 11 games.

headline: Stone (undisclosed) left Friday's game vs. San Jose and is being evaluated.
Blake (rest) is expected to be back in the Hurricanes' lineup on Monday.
news: With Carolina locking up their playoff position over the weekend, Jackson Blake found himself out of the lineup due to rest related purposes but will draw back into the lineup vs. Philadelphia on Monday. The 22-year-old forward has taken a massive step forward in his second NHL season, picking up career highs in goals (22), assists (30), points (52), PIMs (40) and SOG (167) through 79 games played.

headline: Lafreniere (illness) is expected to play vs. Buffalo on Thursday.
news: The Rangers are battling a myriad of key injuries and had a scare on Wednesday when Lafreneiere was absent from practice because of an illness, but he should play on Thursday against the Buffalo Sabres. The 24-year-old Lafreniere has been held off the scoresheet in 28 of 44 games this season and continues to be unable to live up to the expectations he garnered when he was drafted first overall in the 2020 NHL Entry Draft. He has 24 points (9G / 15A) in 44 games this season.

headline: Stankoven (illness) missed practice on Thursday.
news: Stankoven is battling an illness and did not practice on Thursday, but will be hopeful to play when Carolina opens the postseason on Saturday. Stankoven has been an effective offensive contributor in his previous two postseasons and hopes to carry his late-season momentum into a deep playoff run for the Hurricanes. The 23-year-old has nine points (7G / 2A) during a six-game point streak.

headline: Jarry will start vs. Seattle on Friday.
news: After a disappointing introduction to the Oilers in the 2025-26 season, Jarry has been reliable on most nights in 2026-27. That said, he struggled in his most recent game, allowing four goals on 27 shots (.852 SV%) in a 5-4 shootout loss to the St. Louis Blues. It snapped a six-game stretch in which Jarry allowed three or fewer goals in each game (4-0-2). The Oilers enter Friday's outing as -203 home favourites against the Seattle Kraken, who are coming off a 3-1 loss to the Chicago Blackhawks.

headline: Stolarz will start in Boston on Friday.
news: When the Maple Leafs signed Bobrovsky to a three-year, $7 million AAV contract ($21M total) in the offseason, the hope was that he could solidify their crease and return the team to the postseason. That said, Bobrovsky has played poorly, so Stolarz will return to the crease on Friday for the fifth time in six games. The 32-year-old Stolarz played well in his most recent game, helping the Maple Leafs snap a miserable nine-game losing streak (0-8-1), saving 20 of 22 shots (.909 SV%) in a 4-2 win over the New York Islanders. The Maple Leafs enter Friday's game as +146 road underdogs against the Boston Bruins, who have scored two or fewer goals in four of their past six games (2-4-0).

headline: D'Astous will draw into the lineup on Saturday.
Levi will start vs. Vegas on Tuesday.
news: Levi is coming off his worst performance since opening night, allowing seven goals on 36 shots (.806 SV%) in Saturday's 7-4 loss to the Carolina Hurricanes. The 24-year-old goalie has been consistent most of the season, so Tuesday's game against the Vegas Golden Knights will be a good test of how he responds. Before his most recent blip, Levi was on a solid run, posting a 2.08 GAA and .923 SV% in an 11-game stretch (9-2-0). The Oilers enter Tuesday's game as +104 home underdogs against a Golden Knights team that snapped a four-game losing skid (0-1-3) on Saturday with a 5-4 win over the Winnipeg Jets.

headline: Harley (Olympics) will return vs. Seattle on Wednesday.
news: Harley played a prominent role on the blueline for Team Canada during their Silver Medal performance at the Olympics, scoring four points (1G / 3A) in six games, and hopes to carry that momentum back to Dallas. The 24-year-old Harley has 23 points (5G / 18A) in 45 games this season and had five points (3G / 2A) in five games leading into the Olympic break.

headline: Hintz (hand) practiced on Monday and is expected to play vs. Boston on Tuesday.
news: Hintz exited Saturday's 4-0 win over the Chicago Blackhawks in the third period after blocking a shot and did not return. The oft-injured Hintz has had several early-season injury scares already, but he has yet to miss a game. He has five points (3G / 2A) in eight games this season.

headline: Point (undisclosed) will play on Tuesday.
Barkov (knee) will return vs. Ottawa on Wednesday.
news: Barkov missed the entire 2025-26 season after undergoing surgery to repair ACL and MCL injuries. After a strenuous recovery, the 31-year-old Barkov was ready to return as an elite offensive producer, but he was sidelined again after suffering a lower-body injury in the second game of the season. That said, Barkov has been practicing with the team regularly over the past weeks and will return on Wednesday against the Ottawa Senators.

headline: 3-year, $9,750,000 contract with the New Jersey Devils. Expires 2029 (UFA).
3-year, $3,225,000 contract with the Chicago Blackhawks. Expires 2029 (RFA).
